    A

    ASCIIDOC_INCEPTION - Static variable in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.Ike
    The inception stamp's AsciiDoc-document-module counterpart, at the same declared time: the module dimension alone separates the AsciiDoc document vocabulary (AsciiDocModelSet) from the foundation terminology, so a store can carry or omit it as a unit (IKE-Network/ike-issues#468).
    ASCIIDOC_MODULE - Static variable in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.Ike
    The AsciiDoc document module — the export dimension that carries or omits the AsciiDoc document vocabulary as a unit (IKE-Network/ike-issues#468); declared by AsciiDocModelSet.

    C

    compose() - Method in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.IkeSource
     
    compose(KnowledgeSet) - Static method in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.foundation.FoundationSet
     

    D

    DEFAULTS_INCEPTION - Static variable in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.Ike
    The inception stamp's Defaults-and-templates-module counterpart, at the same declared time: the module dimension alone separates support content (the Data Type Defaults tuple, the worked Preferred Reviewer default) from the foundation terminology — see the live-and-die invariant on DefaultsTemplateTerm.DEFAULTS_AND_TEMPLATES_MODULE.

    F

    FoundationSet - Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.foundation
    Composes every ingested-foundation section onto the caller's KnowledgeSet (IKE-Network/ike-issues#872).

    I

    Ike - Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.terms
    Ledger-internal handles for the IkeFoundation knowledge set: the session root and the reference handles the sections cite.
    IKE_COMMUNITY - Static variable in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.Ike
    Community authorship: the IKE Network itself, attributed as author for content synthesized by tooling on the Network's behalf (starter-set ingest, IKE-Network/ike-issues#872) rather than by an individual editor or an ingested upstream source.
    IkeSource - Class in network.ike.foundation.ike.terms
    The IkeFoundation ledger's composition entry: build tooling discovers this source, composes the sections, and replays the session.
    IkeSource() - Constructor for class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.IkeSource
    Creates the source (ServiceLoader requirement).
    INCEPTION - Static variable in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.Ike
    The pre-release set's ONE declared inception stamp (IKE-Network/ike-issues#894): every version this ledger writes outside the Defaults and templates module carries it.

    K

    KERNEL - Static variable in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.Ike
    The kernel: the components tinkar-core and its stores name in their own code, generated into dev.ikm.tinkar.terms.KernelConcept and KernelPattern and committed there (see KernelBindings).
    KOMET - Static variable in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.Ike
    Komet's terms: the components Komet and its plugins name beyond the kernel, generated into dev.ikm.komet.terms.KometConcept and committed there (see KometBindings).

    M

    MODULE - Static variable in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.Ike
    The set's module concept — the export dimension for this knowledge.

    network.ike.foundation.ike.terms - module network.ike.foundation.ike.terms

    R

    ROOT - Static variable in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.Ike
    The set's root concept.

    S

    SET - Static variable in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.Ike
    The knowledge set — its UUID is the permanent type-5 namespace from which every identity in the set derives.
    STAMPS - Static variable in class network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.Ike
    The binding class of the set's stamps: the generated IkeStamp enum, through which code outside the ledger authors under the set's stamps without depending on it.
